Reject documents exceeding the configured size limit

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"document_max_size\":100,\"download_documents\":true,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
```
